description_en: Retrieves the extended information of a support agent
name: GetAgentHotlinePhone

parameters.help_en: The unique client request ID used for idempotency checks. You can use a UUID
parameters.help_zh: 客户请求唯一id，用于幂等校验，可以用uuid生成
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service instance. You can view the instance ID in the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID，在智能联络中心控制台上可以看到
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the agent account (unique value). This is the mapping between the external account and the XP account logon name
parameters.help_zh: 坐席账号名称(唯一值)，外部账号与XP账号登录名的映射
parameters.name: account_name

Code.description_en: The error code. This parameter is empty when Success is true
Code.description_zh: 错误编码，当success为true时，该字段为空

Message.description_en: The error message. This parameter is empty when Success is true
Message.description_zh: 错误描述，当success为true时，该字段为空

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to track the cause of errors
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，用于跟踪错误原因

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the API call was successful
